description: Source code for a Zephyr sensor driver implementing RTIO sensor data handling, including buffer management, data decoding, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: sensor_submit_fallback
methods.description: Fallback function to submit sensor data when the driver API's submit method is not available.

methods.name: sensor_iodev_submit
methods.description: Handles submission of sensor data, using driver API or fallback.

methods.name: compute_num_samples
methods.description: Calculates the number of samples needed based on requested channels.

methods.name: compute_header_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the header for sensor data frames, considering alignment.

methods.name: compute_min_buf_len
methods.description: Calculates the minimum buffer length needed for sensor data.

methods.name: check_header_contains_channel
methods.description: Checks if a header already contains a specific channel.

methods.name: get_frame_count
methods.description: Returns the number of frames in a buffer for a specific channel.

methods.name: sensor_natively_supported_channel_size_info
methods.description: Provides size information for supported sensor channels.

methods.name: get_q31_value
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Q31 value for a channel from the header.

methods.name: decode_three_axis
methods.description: Decodes three-axis sensor data from buffer.

methods.name: decode_q31
methods.description: Decodes single Q31 sensor data from buffer.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes sensor data for a specified channel from buffer.
